attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 23, `infB` to `rsmI`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 5% of calls. The model names 95 to 100% of them, fewest at column 9, `yhbW`, 95%.

**The first fork and variable stretch follows**, columns 24 to 42, all shell, carried by 54 to 89%, the most plastic stretch of the window. Columns 24 to 27, `yraK` to `yraH`, are [[fimbrial proteins]]. Then columns 28 to 31, `agaI` to `agaB`, are [[galactosamine transport]]. The spine at columns 43 to 47, `garD` to `garK`, is [[galactarate and glycerate]].

**The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 94%, and hesitates less there, 0.13 against 0.31 bits. Its most hesitant column, 25, `yraJ`, is a variable column, 0.93 bits.

**The window ends on a fork.** Columns 77 to 79, `uxaA` to `sstT`, are carried by 79 to 87% of chromosomes, all persistent. The last column is `sstT`, in 79% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.18 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.39 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 91% against 96%.

label: infB
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the infB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor infB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 536 to 615 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying infB once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,508 calls, named 98%, 0.09 bits; shell 10,560 calls, named 86%, 0.42 bits; cloud 132 calls, named 11%, 3.66 bits. Outside an RGP 34,126 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 9,074 calls, named 91%, 0.39 bits. Columns: 55 spine, 4 fork, 21 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.39 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (91% against 96%); 9,074 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 25 (yraJ, a variable column) 0.93 bits, RGP 89%; column 26 (yraI, a variable column) 0.73 bits, RGP 92%; column 24 (yraK, a variable column) 0.72 bits, RGP 87%. The 18 columns (columns 24-41) where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.31 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 95%, 0.15 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 55 spine columns: named 95%, 0.13 bits on average; the 25 fork and variable columns: named 94%, 0.31 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 25, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 24-42 (fork and variable columns), RGP 40-92%; the least: columns 0-23 (spine), RGP 0-5%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-23 (24 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: infB, rbfA, truB, rpsO, pnp, nlpI, yrbN "protein YrbN", deaD, mtr, yhbW "luciferase-like monooxygenase", ubiV, ubiU, ubiT "ubiquinone anaerobic biosynthesis a…", yhbS "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", yhbQ "DNA damage response exodeoxyribonuc…", yhbP "YhbP family protein", yhbO "protein/nucleic acid deglycase", yraR "NAD(P)H-binding protein", yraQ "permease", dolP, diaA, yraN "YraN family protein", lpoA, rsmI. named 95-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 9 (yhbW), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 9 (yhbW)).
[S2] 2. columns 24-42 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: share 54-89%, all S, RGP 40-92%. named 89-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 25, named 89%, 0.93 bits.
[S2.c24-29]    columns 24-29 variable, share 54-87%, all S: yraK "fimbrial protein" 60%, yraJ "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher…" 55%, yraI "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone" 55%, yraH "fimbrial protein" 54%, agaI 87%, agaD "PTS galactosamine transporter subun…" 86%
[S2.c30]    30 fork: agaC S 83%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 23%
[S2.c31-42]    columns 31-42 variable, share 79-89%, all S: agaB 87%, kbaY 88%, agaS 89%, nagA 85%, agaF "PTS galactosamine/N-acetylgalactosa…" 88%, agaE 87%, agaW 88%, agaV 89%, kbaZ 88%, agaR 89%, yhaV "type II toxin-antitoxin system ribo…" 79%, prlF 88%
[S3] 3. columns 43-47 (5 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 2-4%. Genes: garD, garP "galactarate/glucarate/glycerate tra…", garL, garR, garK. named 91-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 47 (garK), named 91%; most hesitant at column 44 (garP), 0.45 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 48-49 (2 columns) variable: share 59-73%, all S, RGP 2-3%. named 84-93% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 48, named 84%, 0.72 bits.
[S4.c48]    48: yhaC S 59% "YhaC family protein"
[S4.c49]    49: yhaB S 73% "protein YhaB"
[S5] 5. columns 50-62 (13 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 1-2%. Genes: tdcR, tdcA, tdcB "bifunctional threonine ammonia-lyas…", tdcC, tdcD, tdcE, tdcF, tdcG, cyuP "amino acid permease", cyuA, yhaL "protein YhaL", yhaK "pirin family protein", yhaJ "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…". named 73-94% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 58 (cyuP), named 73%; most hesitant at column 50 (tdcR), 0.24 bits.
[S6] 6. column 63 variable: share 79%, all S, RGP 1%. named 76%; 0.16 bits.
[S6.c63]    63: yhaI S 79% "DUF805 domain-containing protein"
[S7] 7. columns 64-76 (13 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 1-11%. Genes: yhaH "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yqjG "glutathionyl-hydroquinone reductase…", yqjF "DoxX family protein", yqjK "YqjK-like family protein", yqjE "phage holin family protein", yqjD "DUF883 family protein", yqjC "DUF1090 family protein YqjC", mzrA, yqjA "DedA family general envelope mainte…", yqiM "protein YqiM", exuR, exuT "hexuronate transporter ExuT", uxaC "glucuronate isomerase". named 91-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 74 (exuR), named 91%, 0.26 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 77-79 (3 columns) fork: share 79-87%, all P, RGP 3-7%. named 96%; most hesitant at column 77, 0.20 bits.
[S8.c77]    77: uxaA P 87%; also ygjK P 11%
[S8.c78]    78: ygjV P 83% "YgjV family protein"; also ygjQ P 35%, higA S 17%
[S8.c79]    79: sstT P 79%; also alx P 57%, ygjR P 46%, ygjP P 30%
